english.note: Use 真正 as the all-purpose adjective for something genuinely or really what it is, rather than nominal or fake.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for something genuinely real, or to emphasise the particular or exact thing meant.
This is the all-purpose choice for something being genuine or real, especially before 嘅 + noun.
Use 真正 when you want to stress that something is genuine or authentic rather than merely claiming to be so.
Use 真正 for something genuinely or legitimately of the stated kind, such as a true king.
